appName.message: AI Energy Monitor: Track your Token-Consumption

appDesc.message: Track the energy consumption of your AI usage in watt-hours – with efficiency mode and everyday comparisons.

firstDetectMsg.message: Click here to set up EnergiScout – $1 is now being tracked.

obDesc.message: Select your Documents folder – the 'AI Energy-Monitor' folder will be created automatically inside it and your data stored permanently.

obNote.message: The 'AI Energy-Monitor' folder will be created automatically

obError.message: No folder selected. Please try again.

tip1.message: A single ChatGPT query uses 10x more electricity than a Google search. Does it really need to be AI?

tip2.message: Precise prompts = fewer follow-ups = less electricity. Every follow-up question costs the planet.

tip3.message: AI data centers consume more water than entire cities. Your prompt needs cooling.

tip4.message: Before you ask: Maybe it's already in the docs? That saves 100% AI energy.

tip5.message: Did you know? If every person made 10 AI queries per day, we'd need 10 new power plants.

tip6.message: 'Answer briefly' – two words that can cut power consumption in half.

tip7.message: Collect your questions. One detailed prompt instead of 5 small ones saves 80% energy.

impactGoogle.message: That equals $1 Google searches. Would Google have been enough?

impactLed.message: That's how much electricity an LED lamp uses for $1 minutes. For a few questions.

impactPhone.message: Your AI usage today could charge a phone to $1%. Just by typing.

impactAfrica.message: A person in Africa uses about 200 Wh per day. You used $1 Wh just for AI.

impactCo2.message: Your AI usage today caused about $1g CO2. That's $2m of driving.

impactWater.message: With $1 Wh you could boil $2 liters of water. All for AI chats.

impactCooling.message: AI data centers need millions of liters of cooling water. Your share today: about $1 liters.

impactFridge.message: $1 Wh – a fridge runs for $2 hours on that. Your AI usage is not invisible.

impactTv.message: Daily limit exceeded. $1 Wh – as much as a TV running all evening.

impactWashing.message: $1 Wh. A washing machine uses 300 Wh per cycle. Almost there – just by chatting.

impactMax.message: $1 Wh. That's more than some people use in an entire day. Just for AI.

notifLimit.message: $1 Wh consumed – more than a washing machine per cycle. Just from AI usage. Time to ask more consciously.

googleSuggestion.message: You could have answered this question via Google – that saves about 90% energy!

settingsIntro.message: Configure which AI services should be tracked.

standardServicesDesc.message: You can deactivate these services if needed.

optionalServicesDesc.message: Enable additional AI services that you or your colleagues use.

energyProfileDesc.message: Choose which scientific study to use as the energy calculation basis. The default (Sam Altman / OpenAI) is the most publicly recognized value.

profileAltmanDesc.message: 0.34 Wh average · publicly acknowledged value (OpenAI CEO, Jun. 2025)

profileJeghamDesc.message: 0.44 Wh average · conservative, peer-reviewed GPU measurement (arXiv:2505.09598)

profileEpochDesc.message: 0.30 Wh average · FLOP-based derivation, most conservative estimate (Feb. 2025)

googleBaselineDesc.message: Choose which data source to use for the energy cost of a regular Google search (without AI).

googleBaselineClassicDesc.message: 0.3 Wh per search · official Google figure, still widely cited (conservative)

googleBaselineRevisedDesc.message: 0.04 Wh per search · recalculated for modern hardware, not officially confirmed by Google

testcenterAndDataDesc.message: Test center for checking the extension and managing stored data.

confirmClearData.message: Really delete all tracking data? Settings will be preserved.

devtestIntro.message: Here you can check if the extension is working correctly. Work through the sections from top to bottom.

section1Desc.message: Checks if the extension is correctly loaded in your browser and if all parts can communicate with each other.

section2Desc.message: Simulates an AI query without actually opening the page. Click on a service – if a confirmation appears in the result field below, tracking works.

section3Title.message: 3. Does the extension detect real websites?

section3Desc.message: Keep this window open and open a new tab with e.g. ChatGPT or Google. If you type something and submit, a message should automatically appear below.

liveWaiting.message: Waiting... open an AI service in another tab now

section4Desc.message: Generates 7 days of random test data so you can test the popup and dashboard with content without having to collect real data for days.

confirmTestData.message: Note: Test data will be generated for 7 fictional days BEFORE your real data (Day -14 to Day -8). Real data will be preserved.

testDataGenerated.message: 7 days of test data generated. Real data was NOT overwritten.

section5Desc.message: Shows all stored extension data in raw format (JSON). Useful to check what exactly is being saved.

section6Desc.message: Checks for each registered AI service whether the URLs are reachable and correctly detected.

urlCorsBlocked.message: reachable (CORS blocked, but registered in manifest)

dashFooter.message: All data stored locally · AI Energy Monitor
